text:
deploy-bot: rollout complete: release=2026.3.4 region=us-west-2 commit=abc1234. smoke probes (prefill, kvprobe, embed-synth) started.

alex: quick heads-up — embed-route p95 jumped to ~260ms right after rollout (baseline ~95ms). small spike but persistent for 2m.

sarah: i'm seeing a couple 503s from prefill-worker-2 around the same time. log snippet: `ERROR prefill: upstream 502`

prateek: can we do a focused synthetic run against embed-route + prefill-worker-2? runbook threshold: hold if p95 > 200ms for >5m.

jamie: linking runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/release-prefill-checklist — follow the "pin-and-observe" section. :link:  Also check autoscale logs for prefill.

oncall-mike: i've applied a temporary routing pin to previous variant for embed-route in us-west-2 to stop rollout impact: `rwctl pin-route embed-route v2026.2.9 --reason "postdeploy p95 spike"`

deploy-bot: routing pin applied by oncall-mike. canary traffic -> 0% for embed-route in us-west-2. continuing smoke probes for 10m.

alex: re-ran a direct kv warmup check: ```curl -sS -H "x-api-key: $KEY" https://us-west-2.redwood.api/embed -d '{"input":"warmup"}' | jq '.latency_p95'``` -> 92ms now.

sarah: 503s cleared from prefill-worker-2, embed p95 back to ~90ms on checks. looks like the pin + warmup helped.

prateek: good recovery. i'll open a follow-up to track prefill worker autoscale config and a synthetic that targets that host: RN-4427.

jamie: can we add a small synthetic (prefill-target) to the nightly smoke suite to catch this host drift next time? tagging infra.

oncall-mike: i reopened canary at 10% for us-west-2 and will observe for 5m; pin remains for safety at 30m TTL.

deploy-bot: canary update: 10% for 5m, no new regressions observed. next scheduled step: +15m from now. please call if anything reappears. :white_check_mark:

alex: proposed postmortem owner: prateek. follow-up tasks: update autoscale policy, add synthetic, add a brief note to release notes about prefill warmup requirement.

prateek: ack, i'll own the follow-ups and postmortem. thanks all.

jamie: marking this thread resolved once the +15m observation completes.
